scheme_name: Karkhandar Scheme For Development Of Craft Sector
other_conditions: The applicant must be a pass‑out trainee or ex‑trainee from a departmental training centre.
The departmental training centre must be run by the Handicrafts & Handloom Department.
The applicant must have an Aadhaar‑linked bank account.
benefits_summary: Provides a stipend of ₹2000 per trainee per month and a lump‑sum honorarium of ₹25,000 per batch to the trainer, disbursed via DBT.
